_comment: FM-1 pre-migration snapshot lock for EDGE-COMPANY-PVT (Company Pvt Ltd + linked Individual co-borrower).
_shift_notes_S77e_step4: Classification (i) FIXTURE-WAS-WRONG for hand-written EDGE_COMPANY_PVT: (a) applicant-level businessEntityType/IndustrySector/Vintage dropped — the V2 builder reads these from loanAnswers via businessProfilePage, not per-applicant; (b) Company applicant's grossIncome/netIncome dropped — Company branch emits `financials` (triplet arrays), not grossIncome, so the hand-written 300000/180000 had no mapping; (c) residenceState/residenceCity on loanTransaction dropped — no BL schema question binds these keys; (d) builder injects title:'Mr.' on Company (deriveTitle default) and isCoApplicant:false on each director; (e) linked Individual's creditScore (730) propagates onto directors[0].cibil via the Company-branch director↔applicant matcher (linkedCompanyId + name match); (f) Individual's roleInApplication is 'Co-applicant' (builder default for the 2nd applicant), not the hand-written 'Co-Borrower'; (g) relationshipWithPrimary:'' is emitted empty because no relationship field was set; (h) numberOfApplicants comes from loanAnswers.numberOfDirectorOrApplicant which we seed via initialAnswers.
